notes.title: DashBored Map Update Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Woah, it's been a while.

There was a time where I just never stopped updating DashBored, adding new things, but it has now been over four years since the last big update to DB, and I thought it was time to do a little cleaning up here and there. Since a lot of people are discovering DashBored for the first time, I wanted to add something to help new players get into the world of the Garden of Vurrus more easily.



This little update adds a few tune ups to old things, as well as some nice new features!

The most major new feature is the addition of a world map!
World Map
This map is accessible from the game's pause menu, and will show your location in the Garden, the location of your next objective, and a few other goodies as well. I hope this will help to prevent new players from potentially getting lost and overwhelmed in the world of the Garden.

Here's a look at it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/2365e54ae6a417a2e9583cf7656a7631861e9b4b.png"]

The map updates in real time, and is accessible at any time!


Vurrus
Various graphics that have been left alone for a long time have gotten overhauled finally! 

This includes all of Vurrus' graphics, including their face sprites, battle sprites, and overworld graphics!

I haven't been happy with Vurrus' appearance for a long time, so I'm happy to finally do this!

Take a look at the difference of Before (top) and After (bottom)!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/ec3bd1b3d29150ad90784df2de909424edbc8d95.png"]


Memorial to Sketchy
This year, one of my best friends who I have ever met, Becca, passed away to Liver Cancer. It has been incredibly hard without her, she has been one of the people who has kept me going throughout these years, and one of the people who has kept me inspired to create all this time. I miss her very much. Becca loved DashBored and its characters, especially Isaac, and I have added a small memorial area to her in the city of Roke. I may add to it more as time passes.

I hope you are doing well Becca, wherever you are. I miss you. Rest well.



Other Changes:

Improved some battle animations

Graphical improvements to the Corrupted Underground Village

New Final Nash encounter music

Player no longer needs to go and find the Mayor of Roke to enter the subway, hopefully removing some tedium from Day 2

Redid various miscellaneous NPC graphics

Nic no longer blushes at the thought of a horrible underwater monster

Redid Temprocal and Damicelle intro designs

Made Cute Bomb more powerful



I thank you all for playing DashBored all of these years, and I hope that these changes will help to make the game more enjoyable and fun for both the returning and new players alike!

Have a great weekend!

-Karb

notes.title: 10/13/2021 Bug Patch Notes
notes.notes:

notes.title: DashBored: Crystal Clear! Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/9a77c3c8e977c85a173a65fb56135ca0d33ae6f1.png
A Brand New Update is now available for DashBored!

This update is mainly an improvement update, meaning that it seeks to clean up and update a lot of old content in DashBored. Even so, a LOT  has changed. Let's take a look!


Improved Face Sprites!
Though the Face Sprites have been slowly changed over the years, many of them have remained old and unedited. A lot of them were rather ugly looking. Now, many characters have had their faces updated to be both more expressive, and more on-model! Take a look! Almost all of the main characters have been affected in some way, as well as many of the background characters as well!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/546f522f3474182fa630cc577a61b341f32576af.png

Improved Battle Backgrounds!
Every single old Battle Background has been remade to fit the resolution of the game properly! If I do say myself, it makes a big difference in how battles look.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/d07a30481f4452eca6e52a4fbf088a84e25f0fb1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/f9749d2e7ef0143ab8d53212287807947bcd4cf3.png

Improved Dialogue!
A lot of old dialogue was somewhat stale and outdated, now, many important scenes have been totally overhauled to be more lore-friendly and less sloppy. I hope you'll enjoy checking out these improved scenes!

Improved Overworld Sprites!
Even More Characters' overworld Sprites have been improved or totally redone!
Some Characters that have redone include:

Eloise
Lord Occidere
Doch Sneg
Madame Lochhart
Rhassago
Final Boss
Old Men NPCs

And a lot more! Have fun checking out these characters in a new crystal clear vision!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/9808624f6701d3de7a6dc900c42df3d88a972394.png

Brand New Music!
A whole collection of new and improved music has been added! Areas with new music include:

Night Meeting with Midori
Russian Hideout
Undersyde
M&J area
Precipice
While Driving
New Boss Music
New Special Enemy Music

And more on top of that!

Improved Area Graphics!
A few places have had their tilesets improved, but most notably Gourdemoore and Undersyde! Check out these places with a fresh coat of paint!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/2f71d6fa9dad1ca6000504ffbf5eda7ec8855397.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/c499dfb4973e06a748475c790a63681bb3df96b7.png

Other Changes!

Overhauled Blackout Roke to be more interesting
Blackout Roke is no longer a random event, and must be found manually
A brand new hidden boss has been added, complete with a new achievement for beating it!
New animations for Willie G.
Allowed players to leave the Temple boss area, preventing softlocks
Redone all water sprites
Sped up water animation to be smoother
Entrance of The Garden has been made more visually interesting
Certain Parallax backgrounds have been redone and improved
Tons of old miscellaneous tiles have been redone
Greatly buffed chainsaw, but made it more expensive


Bug Fixes

Fixed areas where Nic could walk into the sky
Fixed areas missing battle backgrounds
Fixed a few areas where audio was too loud (This is still incomplete, if you find areas with poorly mixed audio, please let me know)


On the topic of Mechana...
For those of you looking forward to DashBored 2: Mechana, Development is moving forward smoothly. I don't have a crazy demo video to show off right now, but I've got a lot of really cool stuff that I can't wait to show off in the near future! Take a look at these screenshots! (Click to Enlarge)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/583401a3c9d12a59d2aca1195241a10b61855f8a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/7970da046ffabd77f30a4bca44d6b62ffc12002b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/5d2aed992c12840b62140cfcb458f94c82919e8c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/f98e5d710196ab393c5cd4c1f473ded01a80d83c.png

I hope you all enjoy everything this update has to offer! I really gave it my all, and I'm very happy with the results.
As always, if you run into any bugs, or just have some feedback, feel free to let me know, I'm always happy to hear from you.

-Karbonic

notes.title: DashBored: New Beauty Update Released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/14b926e8eef314fa1c41acadb5b9cf3a68231633.png

Nearly two years since the last update to DashBored, I'm back at it again with another one! I can't stop myself!

[previewyoutube=EFdx5Ktj1iI;full][/previewyoutube]

Introducing DashBored: New Beauty!
The New Beauty update seeks to update various graphics which have aged poorly since the original release of the game.

Major Changes
Redone Character Battle Sprites
Most of the player battle sprites have remained unchanged since around the original release of the game. Because of that, they looked pretty ugly in retrospect. I've gone through and remade most of them from the ground up. Now, you can truly battle in style!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/27379e689f5b88858cb583b2d31a52164927a8ce.png

Redetailed Enemy Battle Sprites
Like the player sprites, many sprites for enemies have remained absolutely unchanged since release. I've gone in and redetailed almost every single enemy sprite in the game, making them much more visually appealing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/12be94adb6c89beff6b1d98450a91bc5ace90852.png

Redetailed Player overworld Sprites
I've cleaned up a few of the main character overworld sprites. These should help these older designed characters to mesh with the overworld.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/d5d1c792a1bafcf8bff8e3f69cdffd0ddd74d66f.png

Redrawn Cutscene Graphics
Multiple cutscenes have had their graphics redone! I'll let you find them on your own, I think they're a huge improvement!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/659075cb14db83910378964572df9dfe1cf68038.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25342144/7b8d72204ea04982f6e61030681cbe62189fdd2b.png

Misc. Changes / Fixes

Fixed almost all typos/grammatical errors - The Garden has never been this literate!
Redone default battle theme
Redone Vurrus battle theme
Completely remade final Vurrus Encounter cutscene from the ground up
Redone final boss graphics (Fancy!)
Fixed a problem where character portraits would get cut off during battle.


I hope you enjoy playing through this update, the Garden has never looked better! As always, there's nothing better than developing for you all! Stay cool, everyone!

-Finn T.

notes.title: DashBored Abduction Update Released!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/7823eb19386a0e3530a69b69a511df751b09eed2.png

A new big update for DashBored has just been released, just in time for Halloween!

Something new has arrived in the Garden, its presence different than that of anything previously encountered...

Improvements

Redone Boss Sprites

I've gone and redid all of the old boss graphics to bring them up to par with the rest of DashBored's graphics. Along with this, some bosses have been tweaked to help balance and improve the battle gameplay.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/136f5b16077b138632ac015dca0c37fb2cf38cee.png

New Cutscenes

A handful of new and improved cutscenes have been added to the game, to help add to the atmosphere of the game, including a brand new introduction cutscene for Vurrus! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/a884f48befc2df14da49fdb8cde63d82cc7f61b7.png

Improved Jack Moveset
Jack has had his moves tweaked and has been given a some new moves to help fill out his moveset and make him a more viable alternative to Midori.


New Content
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/08446be2544cb373d629d8b6b127e8fc89b0cee9.png
New Ending Path
This is by far the biggest part of this update. A new pathway to unlock a brand new ending has been added! This path will be unlocked after beating the game and achieving the best ending. This new path will feature brand new bosses, events, and music! Find the answer to the biggest mystery the Garden has ever known! Lies! Deception! Intrigue! All will be found in the new ending of DashBored!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/08446be2544cb373d629d8b6b127e8fc89b0cee9.png

Other than all of that, a few minor tweaks have been added in certain areas like Roke and the hidden village to make them play a bit easier and look a bit easier on the eyes. I hope you will enjoy finding all of the new secrets this update has to offer!

Happy Halloween from Fading Club Games!

notes.title: DashBored: Justice Update Released!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/59a8f6cef1601bcd3a4660afb0c8b75cb1791388.png

After all this time in development, the final update to DashBored is finally here!

DashBored: Justice is by far the largest update made to DashBored. Yes, even bigger than the Halloween Update. Much, much bigger. I'm not kidding! Even I am slightly scared by its sheer size!

The improvements to the game are as follows:

Brand new story path and Ending!

The most important part of this update is the addition being made to the story of DashBored. Follow Nic and his degenerate friends as they go on their biggest adventure yet in a brand new branching story path!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/c48ddfced75bdcdce6183a6e869f93475a7c7f8e.png

Six New Major Locations!

The Garden just got a lot bigger! New optional dungeons! New Secret Areas! Game Shows! Can you find all that the Garden has to hold!?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/1fba14517c7cf3bb4bb401d229352710022679bd.png

Brand New Party Member!

There's a new personality in the Garden, and it's a big one!
Can Nic convince them to join his cause before it's too late!?
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/ea56feba0f2274fbf27c97c0da6d15468c7a3feb.png

45+ new music tracks!

If you liked the OST of DashBored, you'll love the brand new songs that have been composed just for this update!

30+ New Enemies!
The Garden has gotten even more dangerous since you were here last. 
Battle it out with over 30 new Enemies and bosses made especially for this update!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25342144/ea4ccfb5dc332a54f71b42ae02f0921b6e644f2c.png
Some other improvements included in this update:


    New Secret Events
    Improved Battle Animations
    Improved General Graphics
    General Bug-fixes / Performance tweaks 
    Much, much more that I'm forgetting about


It's been a long road, but we are finally here. I sincerely thank you for playing DashBored, and I hope you will enjoy DashBored: Justice!

-Finn "Karbonic" Tanguay

notes.title: HUGE Update Coming...

-New and improved battle sprites
-Completely remade Coton (will make it more concise and easier to explore)
-Fixing a lot of glitches (thanks for bringing them to my attention)
